q: Who in a small company should deal with the GHG verifier?
title: Who should face the verifier
short: One person who owns the carbon figures and can answer quickly, usually from finance or plant engineering, with access to bills, fuel records and production data. The owner or director should sign off the final statement.
audience: Owners and managers of MSMEs going through their first verification

ul: Has time during the verification window.
Plant staff for meter readings and logbooks.
Accounts for invoices and production returns.

p: Leaving it to a consultant who does not know the plant slows every question down.

senseible: Senseible keeps each record with its source document, fingerprint, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any figure back to the bill it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, validation and verification of GHG statements
